# storage

The object storage a tenant owns: buckets, storage users, and their access keys.

## GET /v1/silos/{silo_id}/tenants/{tenant_id}/storage/buckets

Operation `silo_tenant_storage_bucket_list`.

List the buckets owned by a single tenant's storage workspace. Mirrors `storage_cluster_bucket_list`, but pre-resolves the `(cluster_id, workspace_name)` pair from the tenant binding on the URL so the caller never sees buckets owned by a sibling tenant. Intended for the operator webui's "filter by silo+tenant" view; the cluster-flat endpoint stays operator-flat by design.

Cross-silo defence: a tenant in silo B reached via silo A's URL returns 404, not 403, so probes cannot learn that the tenant exists in another silo.

Failure modes:

* 412 `TenantStorageUnbound` — the tenant has no `storage_workspace_id` / `storage_cluster_id` binding yet (run `silo_tenant_storage_init` first). * 404 — tenant does not exist or belongs to another silo.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `silo_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `stats` | query | no | boolean |  |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: array of [StorageBucket](schemas.md#storagebucket)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## GET /v1/silos/{silo_id}/tenants/{tenant_id}/storage/users

Operation `silo_tenant_storage_user_list`.

List the IAM users owned by a single tenant's storage workspace. Mirrors `storage_cluster_user_list` but pre-resolves the `(cluster_id, workspace_name)` pair from the tenant binding on the URL so the operator-ui "filter by silo+tenant" view never enumerates users owned by a sibling tenant. The cluster-flat endpoint stays operator-flat by design. (monitor-reef-nbdp)

Cross-silo defence: a tenant in silo B reached via silo A's URL returns 404, not 403, so probes cannot learn that the tenant exists in another silo.

Failure modes:

* 412 `TenantStorageUnbound` — the tenant has no `storage_workspace_id` / `storage_cluster_id` binding yet (run `silo_tenant_storage_init` first). * 404 — tenant does not exist or belongs to another silo.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `silo_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: array of [StorageUser](schemas.md#storageuser)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## GET /v1/silos/{silo_id}/tenants/{tenant_id}/storage/users/{user}/access-keys

Operation `silo_tenant_storage_user_access_key_list`.

List a single user's access keys, tenant-scoped. Mirrors `storage_cluster_user_access_key_list` but pre-resolves the `(cluster_id, workspace_name)` pair from the tenant binding so the operator-ui view never enumerates keys owned by a sibling tenant's user. (monitor-reef-8imp)

Cross-silo / cross-tenant defence: a user that lives in another workspace (even with the same login name) surfaces as 404 from mantad's workspace gate — `secret_access_key` is always omitted on list responses.

Failure modes: same as [`silo_tenant_storage_user_list`] plus 404 when the named user does not exist in the tenant's workspace.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `silo_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `user` | path | yes | string |  |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: array of [StorageAccessKey](schemas.md#storageaccesskey)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
